title: Bug 641232: [Subcontracting] Offer to install missing apps instead of hard error when disabling Legacy Subcontracting
summary: In the IT localization, disabling Legacy Subcontracting on Manufacturing Setup no longer stops with a hard error when the Subcontracting or IT Subcontracting Migration app is missing. It now offers to install the missing app; the user then runs the disable action again.
key_points: Replaced hard error with inline app installation offer for missing Subcontracting or IT Subcontracting Migration apps
Uses ExtensionManagement.InstallMarketplaceExtension pattern, triggering session reload to re-run the disable process
Pre-Check action also provides install option instead of dead-ending
Method signature unchanged to maintain compatibility with existing cross-app calls
Removed unused error labels for app-not-installed scenarios
